ns0:entry.ns0:title: v0.13.2
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Fixed

  • 🔓 Chat over plain HTTP. Opening Open WebUI over plain HTTP at a LAN or Docker address now loads new and existing chats instead of staying on a spinner with "crypto.randomUUID is not a function". #3391

ns0:entry.ns0:title: v0.13.1
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Added

  • 🦾 Coding agents as models. On an Open Terminal that offers agents, coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Pi now appear in the model picker. You can chat with them or call them by voice, choose their reasoning effort and service tier, and approve their tool requests in the chat. Each conversation uses one agent, and agent chats cannot be regenerated,

ns0:entry.ns0:title: v0.13.0
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Added

  • 📑 Tabbed workspace. The Tabs button at the top of a chat now opens a workspace for files, multiple terminal sessions, artifacts, previews, voice calls and comments. ns0:entry.ns0:title: v0.12.5
ns0:entry.ns0:content:
Added

  • 🧭 Analytics session explorer. Administrators can now open a Sessions tab in Admin Analytics that lists each chat with its tokens, responses, errors and time span, filters them by search, model, token range or sub-agents, and shows a chat's saved replies and tool calls with their timing and outcome, as long as "ENABLE_ADMIN_CHAT_ACCESS" is on.
